items.author: Trump
items.text: Under my leadership, our Economy is booming! New Businesses created in America have reached ALL-TIME HIGHS — Over 500,000 new Businesses formed every month this year. Unlike the Communists that want to tax our Small Business Owners to “death,” my Administration and Republicans in Congress rewarded them with the Largest Tax Cuts in American History, which EVERY Democrat voted against. I WILL ALWAYS FIGHT FOR THE AMERICAN PEOPLE! President DONALD J. TRUMP
